status: Available style specification; final outputs require format-specific visual checks
source: Original interpretations of style names demonstrated in a user-supplied video; not recovered source code.
quality_checks: Readable text and measured contrast against rendered colors
No information communicated by color alone
Responsive layout with no horizontal overflow
Content remains readable without blur or animation

motion.reduced_motion: Remove decorative movement and nonessential transitions

name: Premium minimal
summary: Quiet confidence. Warm paper, editorial type, and generous space.
use_when: Use for leadership communication, learning pages, polished documentation, and focused dashboards.
avoid_when: Avoid when dense operational data needs strong schematic relationships.
typography: Georgia, serif for headings; system sans-serif for body text.
layout: Generous whitespace, narrow reading measure, subtle rules, clear hierarchy.
surfaces: Opaque paper surfaces, 12px corner radius, restrained shadow.
essential_traits: One prominent primary action per content block

adaptations.web: Use the tokens and live components; validate keyboard, mobile, contrast, and reduced motion.
adaptations.slides: Preserve hierarchy and palette with native editable shapes and text. Replace motion with static emphasis.
adaptations.documents: Use native headings, readable body text, restrained callouts, and solid reading surfaces.
adaptations.images: Describe composition and material cues; check text and layout separately. Do not claim pixel-exact token fidelity.

prompt: Apply Premium minimal to [DELIVERABLE] for [AUDIENCE]. Purpose: [GOAL]. Preserve all supplied content, existing visuals, and required brand constraints. Georgia, serif for headings; system sans-serif for body text. Generous whitespace, narrow reading measure, subtle rules, clear hierarchy. Opaque paper surfaces, 12px corner radius, restrained shadow. Palette: background #fbfaf7, surface #ffffff, text #222b28, muted #59645e, accent #a3422d, border #dcded8. Essential traits: One prominent primary action per content block; Editorial heading contrast; Warm neutral canvas. Avoid: Decorative gradients; Heavy glow; Low-contrast gray text. Keep motion restrained and optional, respect reduced motion, and provide a static fallback. Adapt the appearance to the requested output format. Keep text legible, controls accessible, and content editable where supported. Resolve mandatory brand conflicts explicitly. Return the design and accurately report performed and unperformed checks.
